notes.title: BlockWorld is Back!
notes.content:
Nine years ago, BlockWorld first went live on Xbox Live Indie Games for Xbox 360. Today, it's available again via Steam for PC!

Big Nostalgia:
After 2012, we updated the Xbox 360 version to include multiplayer, more blocks and lots of items. This game is, and always has been a big sandbox of toys to play with. 

https://i.imgur.com/rZCY7E7.jpg

And every time we released a new block game, BlockWorld was updated to have more items!

So in this game, you'll find loads of toys to play with. There's magic, guns, paints, creatures, hats and armor. And if you remember games like AMP and CraftWorld, you'll recognize the origin of a lot of this content!

Although, this time around you won't see the Xbox Avatars. Instead, there's customizable Voxel Characters. You can be an Elf, Dwarf, Human or a Lizard man.

The Hazzah Engine:
BlockWorld was one of several Voxel games we built using our own engine. It's called the Hazzah Engine, and is built from the ground up to power Voxel titles. It also powered Survival Games, Avatar Miner Paintball, CraftWorld and Survival Games Season Z.

Beta Keys:
You can grab yourself a Beta Key to play BlockWorld before it's release. Head over to our Discord, and say betakey in the #steamkeys channel under BlockWorld.

POP-L0CK, our bot, will DM you. Then just pop the key into Steam and Enjoy!

Goal:
You guys playing this, will give stability feedback on BlockWorld, used to improve the game. BlockWorld has Telemetry built in. So issues will be logged automatically into our server. 

Post screenshots of cool stuff you build too!

Thanks for reading and have fun!
